description: Wire a real QualityWorkflowRunner into production AutoRunner, Bun server, and CLI paths. Closes TD-252. The canonical orchestrator has configurable quality-workflow profiles (none/standard/strict) intended to nest quality stages inside executor dispatch, but production does not yet supply a real QualityWorkflowRunner instance, so non-none profiles fail closed. Build on quality_workflow_hot_path_wiring_20260618 (archived) which produced the QualityWorkflowRunner class — this track wires it into the actual constructor invocation and validates with E2E that a standard-profile sprint runs quality stages end-to-end.
